cc:Work.dc:title: Cloudflare API bottleneck diagnostic measurements
cc:Work.dc:description: Three panels compare R2 operations, reads and transactions. Medians and observed minimum and maximum come from the reviewed diagnostic CSV. Boundaries and small sample counts differ; consult docs/cloudflare-bottlenecks.md.

g.text: October 19, 2026 · unchanged BeyondDB binary · bucket-gated durability · median dot, observed min–max line
¹ Node-wide correlation, not a per-Cell causal span. ² Four successes and one rollout-time failure; failed call excluded from timings.
³ Worker-forwarded timing; other transaction rows use external SDK. ⁴ Distinct fresh tokens in alternating warm/cold shard probes (n=3 each).
Small diagnostic samples explain paths; they do not establish p99 or steady-state capacity. See the report for placement changes and probe failures.
